candidate_relations.reason: The oral spindle-cell malignancy with pleomorphic atypical cells and p63 positivity is consistent with spindle cell squamous cell carcinoma, arising 15 years after irradiation at the same anatomic region.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Sarcomatoid carcinoma is a recognized synonym for spindle cell squamous cell carcinoma; post-radiation specifies the clinical context.
